title: HTML leaderboard export
summary: Render accepted results as one light HTML page. The site should not invent a score.
spec:
Create sparefold/export_html.py exporting render_leaderboard(rows) -> str.

rows is a list of dicts with keys handle (str), points (int), and units (list of str).

Contract, checked by projects/self/checks/check_self_001.py:
- Return a complete HTML document (the string contains <html).
- Include a <table>.
- Sort by points descending, then handle ascending.
- Include every handle and every unit id as visible text.
- Escape handles and unit ids so the characters <script> cannot appear unescaped.
- When rows is empty, the document contains the exact text No accepted results.
- No <script and no external stylesheet or network request.
- Light background, dark text.
- Do not edit the checker, and do not read credentials.
